_readme: Editable copy for the public page. Change wording here, not in build_dashboard.py. No dates and no client names in the scaling block. status is one of: live, in progress, planned.

status_note._readme: Shown under the headline carry. Clear 'text' to hide it.
status_note.text: The Aave V4 Core hub's USDC borrow rate rose above what the vaults earn, so carry is negative at today's rates. KPK raised the health-factor band, the agent repaid about a third of the loan (HF 1.80), and re-lever stays off until the spread recovers.

loop_sleeve.what: a future syrupUSDG loop at about 8x on the Aave V4 Maple spoke
loop_sleeve.share: about 25% of the borrowed stablecoins at first, rising towards 50% as Aave capacity allows
loop_sleeve.limits: Leverage capped at 8x. When borrow costs rise above the loop's yield, the loop is partly unwound. The loop sleeve is never relied on to deleverage the BTC leg.

scaling.intro: The aim is to grow the fund safely and profitably. Each stage adds a borrowing source or a sleeve only once the depth behind it is there, and backup borrow venues mean no single venue caps the fund's size.

stages.adds: WBTC on Aave V4, USDC borrowed on the Core hub with Merkl's rebate, liquid sleeve in two KPK USDC vaults

Borrow USDG on the Core hub and swap it to USDC, a deeper source than USDC; cbBTC as a second deposit asset; borrow sizing that reads rates and hub depth before drawing; a first loop sleeve (syrupUSDG at ~8x on the Aave V4 Maple spoke, ~25% of borrowed stables)
stages.needs: Permissions through governance and a 3-day timelock; Maple lender onboarding; NAV coverage and monitoring for the loop

stages.adds: Larger Aave lines (USDC depth on the Core hub, the Bluechip USDG cap, Maple spoke lines); loop share rising towards 50%; cirBTC as a deposit asset once Aave lists it
stages.needs: Aave capacity; a cirBTC price feed for NAV

stages.adds: Several venues in parallel: Aave V3 Core and Morpho (syrup loops) next to Aave V4
stages.needs: Venue integrations in the execution layer

backup.label: Backup borrow venues
backup.text: Aave V3 Core, Spark (strong for cbBTC) and Morpho. Their permissions are part of the next governance batch, so the fund can move or spread its borrowing when one venue runs short of depth or turns expensive.

milestones._readme: Shown on the share-price chart. Times are UTC. The deposit, seed borrow and re-lever come from the data; these are the events the data cannot name.

testing_phase.label: testing phase
testing_phase.note: KPK test deposits of 0.0002 to 0.0035 WBTC while the agents were set up and tested on the Prime hub

events.label: test deposits and a test redemption
test deposit minted at the last settled price
test debt repaid, debt moved to the Core hub

scope._readme: Cards under the intro, so a reader can scope the fund. status: live or planned. A card with live_if 'maple' switches to live once the fund holds a position on the Aave V4 Maple spoke.

cards.label: Chain
cards.detail: All positions and contracts are on Ethereum; nothing runs on other chains.

cards.label: Collateral and borrow
cards.detail: WBTC as collateral on the Bluechip spoke; USDC borrowed from the Core hub.

cards.label: Liquid sleeve
cards.detail: KPK USDC Yield and KPK USDC Yield RWA, both curated by KPK.

cards.label: Rewards
cards.detail: Pays the Aave borrow rebate and the vault rewards.

cards.label: Fund contracts
cards.detail: Shares token, onchain NAV calculator, and a Safe that acts only through Zodiac Roles permissions.

cards.label: Loop sleeve
cards.detail: syrupUSDG, looped on the Aave V4 Maple spoke.

risk_controls._readme: Thresholds that live in the monitoring setup, which the board cannot read itself. Update the numbers and as_of when they change.
